unsupported_claims: The node2vec paper reports preprocessing for a graph with about 10 million edges taking on the order of minutes on a single multi-core commodity machine.
Section 4 (Scalability) of the paper contains the specific preprocessing duration and hardware specification.
rationale: The evidence contains no preprocessing runtime for a 10-million-edge graph and no hardware specification. The answer hedges but still attributes an 'order of minutes on a single multi-core commodity machine' figure to the paper and points to a section for it, which invents specifics instead of saying the papers do not report it.
